authority.rule: owner-approved architecture plus executable truth; speculative pseudocode is not promoted
authority.canonical_identity: Chronus is the HYBA software-defined quantum-from-maths GPU and heterogeneous execution computer; CPU, iGPU, GPU, cloud accelerator, FPGA/ASIC and future quantum hardware are execution substrates, not product prerequisites.
authority.substrate_rule: Chronus product identity is substrate- and hardware-agnostic. Backend/device evidence describes where a run executed; it never defines whether Chronus exists.

native_chronus_gpu.product_identity: Chronus is the GPU execution product in this mode; the host CPU/GPU/QPU is an implementation substrate, not Chronus's identity.

host_gpu_augmentation.product_identity: Chronus attaches to an available certified host GPU/accelerator to extend or scale that host while preserving the same Chronus workload contract.

substrate_agnostic_execution.evidence_boundary: Native Chronus execution is first-class and does not require a host GPU; device-specific claims remain separate per-lane evidence.
